basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GenAI Product Owner Mindset | 3× Founder & Applied AI Lead | Discovery to Prototype in Days | MBA
basics.summary: Product-owner-by-instinct who ships GenAI 0-to-1 and leads the specialists doing the deep work. Founded 3 AI products solo (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView), each from customer conversation to validated build in weeks. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps steering prompt engineering, RAG, evals, and AI safety across a production multi-agent system (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly). MBA (93.2%), 20+ startups advised at Tenity, Product Owner of Beekeeper features used by 10M+ users. Comfortable equally in a customer interview, a workshop, and a vibe-coded prototype I built the same afternoon.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own AI product delivery end to end: customer discovery, prototype, production, and adoption. Reports to C-level on outcomes. Multi-agent system: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Lead the specialists (prompt engineering, RAG, evals, agentic workflows, AI safety) across a production stack: LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP, AG-UI, LangSmith. Translate their craft into decisions the org can ship.
Design AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j grounding every agent. Kill or scale ideas based on eval results and real user signal, not opinion.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Interviewed and evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC decisions. Customer-discovery muscle built on real founders under time pressure.
Advised portfolio companies on GenAI product strategy, hiring specialists, and running discovery-led cultures that ship.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead) & Product Owner
highlights: Product Owner of the distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Ran the discovery, defined the epics, shipped through 3 teams.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. GenAI 0-to-1: prototype to production, no gatekeepers.
Built and led the AI engineering cohort. Hiring manager for AI roles; grew specialists who now lead features independently.

Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales and PM (Employee Referral $1.5M+ revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Re-ignite Revenue). Every launch shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the metric.

work.name: Obermatt
highlights: Bridged business and engineering on a financial-analytics product. Ran discovery with customers, built roadmaps that lifted satisfaction and retention.
Directed a remote engineering team; agile practices lifted productivity 20%; Docker CI/CD cut deployment time 30%.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery startup in a safety-critical industrial domain. Shipped the full product from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries (99.5% safety record).
Ran discovery with Unilever and secured a CES Las Vegas showcase. Turned prototype demos into narratives partners bought into.
